scope: real Tesseract OCR + deterministic Google transport + production extension

baseline.failure: Cancel 操作条不能发生移除

cases: real language download, OCR, translation and replacement
restore and redisplay reuse result without requests or source mutation
dynamic source change removes old translation
loading Cancel retains the same attached hovered focused row and button during progress
cancel never installs a late result
injected offscreen channel closure retries once with a fresh request and installs a valid bitmap
transparent PNG hides original letters while translated bitmap remains visible
restoring transparent source releases only the extension opacity lease
host opacity change removes old replacement and preserves the host value
